scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic theorem with separately executed reproducible finite numerical cross-checks. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only coherent unweighted hypercubes, uniform positive amplitude loss at an entire affine parity hyperplane, and localized initial states outside it. Even-support capture is incomplete; capture-time mean is conditional on capture. No claim of a global optimum over arbitrary half-size trap sets. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Support-parity phase law and optimal trapping time for affine halfcube detectors
